name: @soli-boy/desktop
description: Soli-boy — shell desktop Electron (ADR-007). Renderer = dist/ di @soli-boy/app.

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:main && cross-env SOLIBOY_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.smoke: npm run build && cross-env SOLIBOY_SMOKE=1 electron .
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:publish: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish always
